title: Strict-local germ restriction is invertible
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point, and $g:S_{(s)}\to S$ the strict-henselization structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. For every abelian étale sheaf $G$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], every map $r:G_s\to\Gamma(S_{(s)},g^{-1}G)$ satisfying the representative-neighbourhood germ restriction equations [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-restriction] is an isomorphism. Here $G_s$ is the geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] and $g^{-1}$ is inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

proof.text: Apply clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-functoriality], implemented by strictHenselizationResidue, using the algebra structure on Omega induced by the given geometric point. Obtain the local and strictly henselian structures, the residue equivalence sigma, and the geometric lift y whose composites with all representative limit legs are their marked points and whose composite with the structural map is s. The map y is the spectrum of the residue map followed by sigma and the inclusion into Omega. The prime-comap formula for a residue map shows y lies over the closed point.

Let P be the inverse image of G on the strict henselization. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-strictly-henselian-sections-stalk] to the closed geometric point y to make the identity-neighbourhood germ gamma an isomorphism. The terminal evaluation isomorphism identifies global sections with sections on this identity neighbourhood. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ] and the equality y followed by the structural map equals s to obtain the inverse-image stalk isomorphism c to G_s with its germ formula. Define r0 as c inverse, followed by gamma inverse and inverse terminal evaluation.

For each representative neighbourhood, the lift y followed by its strict-local section has first pullback projection equal to the marked point, by the residue factorization equation, and second projection y, because it is a section. Pullback extensionality identifies this with the pointed neighbourhood in the inverse-image germ formula. The colimit germ relation for restriction along the section then proves germ followed by r0 equals strictHenselizationSectionRestriction. Cancelling c and gamma gives exactly the defining restriction equations. Uniqueness in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-restriction] yields r = r0; r0 is a composite of isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03QO and 03Q9, canonical restriction construction; the local structure and pointed factorization are supplied by clause (1) of strictHenselizationResidue (Tags 04HX and 03PS).
